gloss: to fail; to blunder; to mess up

definitions.gloss: to fail; to blunder; to mess up; to botch
definitions.explanation: To fail at something due to a mistake or carelessness, especially when the failure has noticeable consequences. Implies personal responsibility for the failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しくじった。
⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{商談|しょうだん}→商談：04877_shoudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しくじってしまった。
examples.english: I messed up an important business deal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧しくじった⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あきらめるな。
examples.english: Don't give up just because you failed once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しくじって⟦{大金|たいきん}→大金：12192_taikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: He messed up with his investments and lost a large sum of money.

notes:
A colloquial verb with a blunt, honest tone. Often used when taking responsibility for one's own failure or when describing someone's mistake candidly. The TV show 「しくじり⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧」 (Shikujiri Sensei — "Teachers Who Blew It"), where celebrities talk about their past failures, made this word widely recognized.

TRANSITIVITY:
Can be used both transitively (⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しくじる — to fail an exam) and intransitively (⟦{商談|しょうだん}→商談：04877_shoudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しくじる — to mess up in a business deal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しくじる: to mess up at work
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しくじる: to fail an exam
- しくじり⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: a teacher who failed (TV show title)
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧しくじる: to fail once

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail — neutral and widely used; lacks the colloquial punch of しくじる
- へま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a blunder — colloquial, often for minor practical mistakes
- ⟦やらかす→やらかす：09375_yarakasu⟧: to screw up — very colloquial/slangy, often implies the mistake was embarrassing
